measurements.technique: Source text with explicit reported/model/context scope

value.value: A 7 nm CdSe core-only sample has about 15% ensemble QY at 680 nm before washing. Washing makes it essentially nonemissive; even the diluted unwashed sample is not visible at single-dot level on a slide. Its synthesis method is not reported and must not be borrowed from the 5.5 nm procedure.
